Company Profile
VRL Logistics Limited is an India-based logistics and transport company that is engaged in the goods transport business. Its core business includes less than truck load (LTL) and full truck load (FTL) offerings. Its services include logistics and other services. Its logistics services include general parcel, courier service business, FTL, and other capabilities. Its general parcel business includes pan-India movement of consignments of varying size and weight across the country on LTL godown to godown basis. Its courier offering is available within the State of Karnataka and offers courier services for time-sensitive documents and packages. It provides door-to door FTL service. It permits the use of its vehicles for branding. It operates with approximately 5949 owned vehicles through over 1241 branches, including 50 hubs in 24 States and five Union Territories. It caters to a range of industries, including textile, pharma, agricultural, machinery, and others.
